positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working in Infra, building tools and driving initiatives to improve Reliability for Coinbase as a whole.  Some of the projects include
  +  Drove alignment with different engineering teams to define and collect key metrics for critical services through multiple automated processes.  Built pipelines to import data into Snowflake and leveraged Looker to aggregate and visualize data to provide signals on engineering health, enabling the execs (which were our main customers) to take appropriate actions.
  +  Worked across different engineering teams including Observability stack to define a common Service Level Objective (SLO) framework and to build a paved-road that auto discovers and creates SLOs for all services within Coinbase.  This helps improve the SLO coverage for all services within Coinbase from from single digit to ~80%.
  +  Designed and implemented an in-house service scorecard that provides a heat map for all eligible services within Coinbase.  The tool includes tens of hourly Airflow DAGs, a notification system, as well as an intuitive UI that reports key metrics such as bug SLA, SLOs, code coverage etc… 
  +  Improved the availability and latency of key foundational microservices to prepare for high load events such as Super Bowl ads.
positions.insights: Skills: Scalability · Python · Project Management · Software Design · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: PMTS, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on various projects in Service Cloud using Java as the primary language. Acting as tech lead
for multiple scrum teams in which I contributed to the architecture and design directions.

Workforce Engagement
Led multiple scrum teams from different time zones to build organically the next generation
product for Service Cloud. Played many roles from technical lead to project management to
ensure key epics are delivered successfully. The product took 2 years to go GA and I helped
grow the organization from a team of 3 to 5 teams totaling 30+ engineers.
Jump-start many areas of the product while simultaneously providing technical guidance to different
teams. Spearheaded an initiative to migrate critical services hosted within the monolithic codebase
into micro-services.
Flew to Tel Aviv to provide in-person training to engineers from an acquired company, helping them
onboard onto Salesforce’s stack.

Knowledge Migration Tool
Led the architect and implementation of the Knowledge Migration Tool that helped bring customers
from a legacy data model to a new data model that is more feature-rich with support of modern UI.
Brought the product from the idea phase to GA. Worked closely with PMs and various
stakeholders to come up with deliverable milestones.
● Migrate millions of records while simultaneously changing the data shape.
● Chunk the process to make it more efficient, helping reduce customer downtime as well as
load on the system.
● Support roll back and partial retries.
● Intuitive UI guiding users through the migration process with real time update, including a
comparison view that displays the before-and-after-migration content of the records.

Knowledge
Tech Lead for 2 scrum teams which own the Salesforce knowledge base system. Worked on various
complex features
● Re-architect the current data model to make it more standard, more performing and
reduce development cost.
● Lead the team effort to implement a brand new UI which aligns with company top
priority.

positions.title: SMTS, Tools Developer
positions.description:
Work on automation framework and tools which enable Performance Engineers to be more effective.
Sample of work includes system statistic harvesters and visualizers which can help pinpoint performance degradation in matter of minutes

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on internal tools and infrastructure.  Products include a build system portal that allowed users from different time zones to efficiently schedule or kick off builds.

patents.title: Data Migration System
patents.description: Disclosed are some implementations of systems, apparatus, methods and computer program products for facilitating data migration. Data migration is customizable according to user-specified data formats. A data migration system monitors the data migration process and automatically retries data migration tasks that have failed. In addition, the results of data migration are reversed according to detected threshold conditions.
